adjust.empty: Select a single clip to adjust it.
adjust.fadesHelp: One fade fades everything: sound where the clip has it, picture where it has one.
adjust.pitchHint: Off keeps the voice where it is. On is tape behaviour - faster also means higher.

adjust.speedHelp: The clip covers the same material either way, so its length on the timeline changes to match.
adjust.transformHelp: You can also drag the picture in the preview - corners scale, the handle above rotates. Double-click any label to reset it, or click a value to type one.

settings.about.basedOn: CtrlBeat is built on {name} (also known as {aka}) by {author}. The editing engine and core desktop shell come from that project; CtrlBeat adds the beat-sync product layer.
settings.about.blurb: Local-first video editing with beat placement, music visualizer, and ASCII overlays. Media, models and renders stay on this machine.
settings.about.highlightAscii: Live ASCII / code-symbol overlays with 13 glyph sets
settings.about.highlightBake: Bake overlays onto a top track so export includes them
settings.about.highlightBeats: Beat detection, timeline marks, and place images/videos on the beat grid
settings.about.highlightEdit: Freeze frame, duplicate clips, fit/match sizing, video source window
settings.about.highlightViz: Music visualizer presets (particles, radial, kaleidoscope, and more)
settings.about.license: Covered sources in this tree: {license}. See LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Upstream Concat may use additional terms on their releases.
settings.about.trademarkNote: Concat and WolfCut names and logos identify upstream builds. This product ships as CtrlBeat.
settings.general.engineNote: Some text from the engine appears in English.
settings.speech.modelsHelp: Both builds carry the same voices and differ only in precision; the compact one is a third of the download and rarely audibly different. The selected build is what Text to speech uses.
settings.speech.privacyNote: Voices download once and are stored locally. Generating speech never touches the network.
settings.title: Settings
settings.transcriber.captionsHelp: Word by word times each caption to the moment its word is spoken (karaoke style), using the transcriber's token timing. Falls back to phrases when the binary cannot provide it.
settings.transcriber.engineMissing: Transcription engine not found in this dev build
settings.transcriber.modelsHelp: Bigger models transcribe better and slower. English-only variants beat the multilingual ones at the same size when the audio is English. The selected model is what Auto captions uses. Everything runs locally - nothing leaves this machine.
